# postlite

> Agents: read `/AGENTS.md` (workflows; docs/agent-guide.md in the repo) and `/api/v1/openapi.json` (full API). MCP endpoint: `/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`), or stdio via `node bin/postlite.js mcp`.
> If the instance sits behind Cloudflare Access, `/AGENTS.md` and `/llms.txt` need a browser login; use the public mirrors `/api/v1/agent-guide.md` and `/api/v1/llms.txt` instead.

postlite is a lightweight, self-hosted social media scheduler for YouTube, Facebook Pages, Instagram (via Facebook Login or Instagram Login), X and LinkedIn (profiles and Company Pages). It runs as one Node.js process with SQLite, or on Cloudflare Workers (D1 + R2 + Cron); the API is identical (`whoami` returns `runtime`). Everything in the web UI is also available through the REST API, the MCP server and the CLI.

## Concepts
- **account**: a connected YouTube channel, Facebook Page, Instagram professional account, X account, LinkedIn profile or LinkedIn Page. Get ids from `list_accounts`. Status `needs_reconnect` means a human must re-authorize (`get_connect_url`).
- **post**: one piece of content (global `content` + ordered `media_ids`) sent to one or more accounts (`targets`). Each target may override `content`/`media_ids` and has platform `settings`.
- **status**: draft → (pending_approval) → scheduled → publishing → published | failed.
- **approval mode**: API keys default to approval mode. Scheduling/publishing with such a key sets `pending_approval`; a human approves in the UI. Tell the user when this happens. You cannot approve with such a key.
- **times**: ISO-8601 with offset, epoch ms, or local `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` in the server timezone (`get_settings`).

## Tools / operations (same names in MCP, REST operationId and `postlite call <name>`)
- whoami, list_platforms, get_settings, update_settings (timezone, time_format "24h"|"12h" for display, posting_slots), list_free_slots (account_id = use those channels' own slots)
- get_workspace_data_summary, delete_workspace_data (admin; {confirm: owner email or workspace name}; deletes ALL of this workspace's accounts, posts, media, keys and settings, never other workspaces or anyone's sign-in; only on an explicit human request)
- list_brands, create_brand, update_brand, delete_brand, set_brand_channels: Brands are named sets of channels (accounts across platforms, e.g. "North Star" = its YouTube + Instagram + Facebook + X). Use a brand id or name as brand_id in create_post / validate_post / update_post ("post this to the North Star brand"), and as the brand filter of list_posts, get_calendar, get_analytics_overview (brand.totals + per-channel accounts[]) and get_top_posts
- list_signatures, create_signature, update_signature, delete_signature: saved snippets; create_post {signature} or {auto_signatures:true}
- list_templates, get_template, create_template (from_post_id or content+targets), update_template, delete_template: reusable posts without media; create_post {template_id}
- list_tags, create_tag, update_tag, delete_tag, set_post_tags: tags (labels with colors) on posts; create_post/update_post take tags (ids or names, unknown names created); filter list_posts / get_calendar / get_top_posts with tag
- list_accounts (each account lists its brands; name = display name, platform_name, disabled = publishing paused, posting_slots), update_account (display_name, disabled pauses publishing without disconnecting [admin], posting_slots = the channel's own next_slot times), get_account, check_account, get_connect_url, disconnect_account
- list_platform_apps, set_platform_app, clear_platform_app, test_platform_app (admin; developer-app credentials, secrets are write-only; human setup guides at /docs/setup/)
- list_media (media library: q, kind, usage used|unused|purged, limit/offset, total, counts; items carry used_by_posts / in_use / deletable), delete_media_bulk (skips media unfinished posts still need), get_media, upload_media_from_url, upload_media_base64, set_media_poster, delete_media (stdio only: upload_media_from_path; REST: POST /api/v1/media raw body)
- create_upload, get_upload, complete_upload, abort_upload: resumable multipart upload for big files (PUT each byte range to its part URL, keep the ETag, then complete). Use this on Cloudflare Workers for anything over ~90 MB
- list_posts, get_post, get_calendar, validate_post, create_post, update_post, schedule_post, reschedule_post, publish_post_now, retry_post, duplicate_post, delete_post, delete_post_target
- list_pending_approvals, approve_post, reject_post
- get_analytics_overview, get_account_analytics, get_top_posts, get_post_metrics, sync_analytics (REST CSV: GET /api/v1/analytics/export.csv)
- list_webhooks, create_webhook, update_webhook, delete_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, list_webhook_deliveries, test_webhook
- list_api_keys, create_api_key, update_api_key, revoke_api_key, list_audit_log
- get_storage, update_storage_settings (admin), cleanup_media (write; dry_run=true reports only): media originals are deleted after publishing (default "immediate" = 30 min after every post using them finished; "7d", "30d", "never"). Purged media keeps its poster/thumbnail; media[].purged = true, url/public_url = null, /m/ original → 410. To reuse it, re-upload the file (duplicate_post lists needs_reupload)

## Platform rules (summary — call list_platforms for the authoritative list)
- YouTube: exactly one video; settings.title required (2–100 chars); description ≤ 5000; Shorts = vertical/square ≤ 180 s (`isShort: true`); privacy public|unlisted|private.
- Facebook Page: text/link, 1–10 photos, or one video (`post_type: post`); Reels one vertical video 3–90 s (`post_type: reel`); stories (`post_type: story`).
- Instagram: ≥ 1 media, JPEG images only; 1 image = image post, 1 video = Reel, 2–10 items = carousel; `post_type: story` for stories; caption ≤ 2200, ≤ 30 hashtags, ≤ 20 mentions; feed image ratio 4:5–1.91:1; ≤ 3 collaborators.
- X: ≤ 280 weighted chars (URLs 23, emoji 2; 25,000 for Premium accounts); up to 4 photos, or 1 GIF, or 1 video; threads via settings.thread = [{text, media: [ids]}] (reply chain); reply_settings. Pay-per-use: every post costs X API credits (posts with a URL cost more).
- LinkedIn (`linkedin` profile, `linkedin-page` Company Page): ≤ 3000 chars; 1–20 images, or 1 MP4 (3 s–30 min, ≤ 500 MB), or settings.post_type "document" + 1 PDF (≤ 100 MB, 300 pages); settings.url for an article card; first_comment and analytics need LinkedIn's Community Management API approval. Tokens last 60 days → `needs_reconnect`.

## Workflows
1. Plan a week: get_settings → list_free_slots(count 7) → list_accounts → for each slot: validate_post → create_post(mode "schedule", publish_at = slot).
2. Video → YouTube Short (+ Instagram Reel): upload_media_from_url (check width < height and duration ≤ 180) → validate_post with targets [{account_id: yt, settings: {title, isShort: true}}, {account_id: ig}] → create_post(mode "next_slot").
3. Fix a failure: list_posts(status "failed") → get_post → read target.error → fix (update_post) → retry_post. If the error says the post "may have been published", ask the user to check the platform first.
4. Weekly report: sync_analytics → get_analytics_overview(from 7 days ago) → get_top_posts(limit 5).

## Errors
JSON `{"error":{"status","message","details"}}`; MCP tool errors return `isError: true` with the same message. 400 = bad input (message lists fields, unknown fields suggest the right name), 403 = missing scope (message names it), 422 = platform validation (per-account list), 409 = state conflict, 429 = rate limit (Retry-After).
